questions.questionText:
The processes of removal of particles in a rapid sand filter with their description is given in
the table.
Process Description
(i) Straining P: Removes only particles in the water large enough to get
caught in the pores of the filter
(ii) Sedimentation Q: Larger and heavier particles do not follow the fluid
streamline around the sand grain and settle on the grain
(iii) Interception R: Particles that do follow the streamline, but are too large
and are caught because they brush up against the sand grains

and may collide with the sand grains by chance
